summary: Starts the deprecation of triple-DES (3DES) and RC4 encryption types in Kerberos because their cryptographic strength is weakening. RFC 4757 was moved to Historic, and RFC 3961 was updated to note that the triple-DES types are deprecated. It is Best Current Practice guidance for implementers and administrators.

eli5.summary: Two old locks keep getting easier to pick. This tells everyone who uses Kerberos to stop buying them and switch to stronger ones.

questions: why deprecate 3des and rc4 in kerberos
